purpose: With c4 fixed to zero, profile the documented Magnicon XXF-1 10 kHz second-order Bessel cutoff across its +/-2.5% manual tolerance and test whether that physical filter plus only c2 can replace the previous free pole/Q effective readout model.
guardrail: The Magnicon manual documents a second-order Bessel output LPF at 10 kHz +/-2.5%, but the filter state during the 2024-12-05/06 acquisition is not known. A successful fit establishes consistency with the LPF-ON hypothesis, not proof that it was ON. c4 is fixed to zero throughout the physical-filter branch. No production data or production noise model are modified.
